<thought>Since the template with ID 84231 is not directly available, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that describes an SN2 substitution where a C–Cl bond is broken and a C–N bond is formed. This should retrieve the appropriate template, after which I can apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
